public_production_path: ThemeYaml.parser -> ThemeDslExpander.expand -> decode Theme (omitted layout width remains0) -> Keyboard(targetContext,theme,1000,config) -> public keys geometry and Key.isInside. Inline click definitions use no KeyCode/name/native resolution. Both production layout passes execute.
initialization: Existing Handler main-thread barrier is the first statement in try before AppPrefs/KeyboardPrefs access. Captured geometry preference snapshot guards finally readback. No manual initDefault.
preference_policy: Helper makes no preference writes and needs no restoration. It records and compares landscape_mode, split_space_percent and expand_keypress_area only. Host remains responsible for full preference mapping/PID metadata/default IME checks. Effective landscape mode must be false, otherwise explicit precondition failure.
oracle: Fixed known coordinates/widths/row/column per finite case plus contiguous positive row heights, total height and same-row height, remainder bound. Each positive key center is checked against all production keys.isInside; matched indices must equal exactly its own key.index. No production width resolver is copied to determine expected geometry. Baseline expected zero coordinates/widths in exactly two omitted-default cases; zero geometry explicitly skips uniqueness and is never reported as a passing center control.
does_not_call: RimeDaemon or Rime session APIs (including getFirstSessionOrNull)
File/image artifacts beyond the host-provided helper source; no target file fixture is created
scope_limits: Actual Android production geometry objects; no real IME/window/View rendering, system touch, full keyboard interaction or visual acceptance

Own-center uniqueness is checked for the39 positive fixture geometries only. Edge flags expand hit regions elsewhere; no guarantee about all coordinates, nearest-neighbor logic or system touch/selection dispatch.
Only explicit finite valid portrait/no-split widths and fixtures covered; no universal invalid/negative/NaN/Infinity/tiny-width validation
A baseline AssertionError is captured inside harness and returned; unexpected constructor errors are caught inside main Runnable to avoid uncaught main-thread FATAL
120s overall watchdog can finish an incomplete run; a running main task cannot be interrupted and report must not be called a product pass
Application startup itself can produce platform/database/work logs; no blanket all-platform-JNI absence or zero-warning assertion
mutations: Only ignored helper/evidence files written by author; no product changes, build/ADB/PR or device execution by author.
